subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: What run-progress observation contract should OpenClaw expose for delegated `sessions_send` runs?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent API shape affects gateway protocol, session authorization, sensitive event redaction, replay retention, and channel delivery behavior.

options.title: Add `sessions_subscribe` plus `agent.events`
options.body: Create a permission-checked polling or long-poll event API with bounded replay/redaction and expose it as an agent tool for delegated runs.

options.title: Bridge progress inside `sessions_send`
options.body: Keep the API narrower by forwarding selected progress updates from the existing send/A2A flow without a general subscription tool.

options.title: Defer to structured process events
options.body: Make #52826 the canonical design and close this later only after it explicitly covers delegated `sessions_send` caller visibility.

recommendation.title: Add `sessions_subscribe` plus `agent.events`
recommendation.body: Create a permission-checked polling or long-poll event API with bounded replay/redaction and expose it as an agent tool for delegated runs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source history places Peter closest to the current `sessions_send` and gateway event routing surfaces.
